maria_cs: FYI — did a quick pass on NovaWave's onboarding telemetry, flagging a proactive perf recommendation before their next spike.
aj_eng: Thanks Maria — quick summary?
maria_cs: TL;DR: steady tail latency at 350-400ms on gen routes, cost ~2.3x vs expected. We can try: 1) int8 quant swap on their inference profile, 2) route 25% of requests to compact model during peak, 3) enable prefix KV caching for repeated prompts.
sam_se: That aligns w/ their typical short-chat workload. Any quality checks done?
maria_cs: Ran 50-sample eval against their prompt set (sanitized). Quality delta ~+0.6% hallucination on int8, responses matched critical fields for 46/50. Ben ran a longer eval yesterday.
ben_research: Confirm — I re-ran a 500-sample pass overnight. Int8 (our q8 profile) shows mean BLEU -0.9, but intent classification stayed >98%. Recommendations: proceed with canary, monitor intent/slot accuracy and token-level perplexity.
aj_eng: Good. For routing, suggest a canary split with automatic rollback on error rate + latency regressions. We can do 25% -> 50% after 24h if stable.
maria_cs: Created a small ops checklist for the customer success + eng handoff: 
- request: enable q8 profile for model: rw-base-13b-v1
- route: add traffic route rule: customer=novaWave && hour in [17,20] -> 25% to rw-base-13b-int8
- cache: enable KV prefix caching, TTL 12h for user prompts
- eval hooks: post-canary eval set + webhook to capture QA failures
- rollback: auto fallback to rw-base-13b-v1 on >2% regression in intent or >200ms latency uplift

sam_se: Can you paste the example route rule config? I'll hand it to infra.
maria_cs: Sure — quick snippet: 
```
route_rule: 
  match: customer == \"novawave\" and region == \"us-west-2\"
  window: \"17:00-20:00\"
  splits: [{model: \"rw-base-13b-int8\", pct: 25}, {model: \"rw-base-13b-v1\", pct: 75}]
  rollback_conditions: [intent_regression_pct > 2, p95_latency_increase_ms > 200]
```
aj_eng: Perfect. I'll schedule the canary for 17:10 PT today. ops_bot: deploy plan queued (id: dp-20260323-007).
ops_bot: [bot] Canary started for dp-20260323-007 at 17:10 PT. Monitoring: latency, errors, intent_accuracy.
maria_cs: I'll message the customer success owner on NovaWave and share the rollout plan + expected outcomes. Sam, can you own the infra side to ensure KV is wired?
sam_se: On it — will confirm KV hooks and webhook for eval results.
ben_research: I'll set up a nightly eval monitor to post a short report into this thread (intent, token diff, hallucination flag).
aj_eng: If early signals look good, plan to increase to 50% after 24h. If any regressions, auto-fallback will trigger and we'll capture logs.
maria_cs: Noted. I'll schedule a 30-min check-in with NovaWave CS tomorrow morning to capture qualitative feedback and decide on next steps for renewal playbook.
sam_se: FYI — estimated cost reduction w/ q8 + 25% routing ≈ 28% on per-token spend for their traffic mix.
maria_cs: Nice. Adding that to the renewal note. Anything else?
aj_eng: Add a short survey to their UI to capture subjective quality: 3 Qs, sent to a webhook we control. Low-friction, helps correlate metrics to UX.
maria_cs: Good call — adding to action list. I'll update the customer-facing doc and ping stakeholders when the canary completes. :thumbsup:
